messages.subject: Error in setnames(x, value) :    Can't assign 4 names to a 0 column data.table
parts:
Hi,

Thanks for updating this fantastic package.  I've been using it for a while now.  However, I updated to the newest release and seem to be having the same issue as others the group.

> input.pd <- PDtoMSstatsFormat(raw.pd_frac,
+                                  annotation.pd_frac,
+                                  which.proteinid = 'Master.Protein.Accessions',
+                                  useNumProteinsColumn = TRUE,
+                                  useUniquePeptide = TRUE,
+                                  #rmPSM_withMissing_withinRun = FALSE,
+                                  #rmPSM_withfewMea_withinRun = FALSE, #features with 1-2 measurements
+                                  removeProtein_with1Peptide = FALSE,
+                               which.quantification = "Precursor.Area",    
+                               which.sequence = "Annotated.Sequence",
+                                  summaryforMultipleRows = sum)
